comments.comment: `[patch.crates-io]` points `bytecheck` at `https://github.com/rkyv/bytecheck` without a pinned `rev` or tag, so every build can fetch and compile whatever the repository's current HEAD contains instead of a locked crate release. That creates a supply-chain trust boundary at build time and is risky if the upstream repo is ever compromised or force-pushed; pin the source to an immutable revision or use a released crates.io version.
